capabilities: Render Unreal Engine Blueprint and Material graph text from blueprint code blocks
Pan and zoom rendered graphs with drag and Ctrl+scroll
Enter collapsed node sub-graphs and return to the top level
Copy the original blueprint text back to the clipboard
Set per-block render height and name labels
extras: Desktop only (mobile not supported). Rendering engine is forked from BlueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition under the MIT License with the original copyright retained.
intentEvidence: Renderer is a modified version of BlueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition (MIT License)
problem: Obsidian cannot visualize Blueprint/Material graph text copied from Unreal Engine, leaving pasted node data as unreadable plain text.

relations.evidence: This plugin is built on top of the original with modifications (left-drag pan, translate3d GPU acceleration, All button, copy code, etc.)

summary: Code-block renderer that displays Unreal Engine Blueprint and Material graph text as interactive, pannable and zoomable diagrams inside notes.
